# GitHub Issue Templates

## Bug Report

### Bug Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Step one
2. Step two
3. Step three

### Expected Behavior

What did you expect to happen instead?

### Actual Behavior / Logs

Paste terminal output, stack traces, or console logs here.

### Environment / OS

e.g. macOS / Chrome v124 / Node v20.10.0

### Severity

Critical / High / Medium / Low

---

## Feature Request

### Feature Summary

Short summary of the proposed feature.

### Problem / Motivation

Describe the problem this solves or the motivation behind this request.

### Proposed Solution

How it should work or be implemented.

### Alternatives Considered

Other solutions you've evaluated (optional).

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Feature works on mobile
- [ ] Added unit tests
- [ ] Updated docs
